children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on October 19, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.

Smartlink Net surged 16.70% to ₹253.50, trading above its 30-day (₹217.23), 50-day (₹218.69), 150-day (₹178.49) and 200-day (₹165.33) simple moving averages (SMAs). Trading above all key averages reflects strong upward momentum and a positive long-term technical trend.

Jay Bharat Maruti advanced 9.47% to ₹132.25, trading above its 30-day (₹120.81), 50-day (₹123.90), 150-day (₹124.78) and 200-day (₹117.61) SMAs. Trading above all key averages indicates strong buying momentum and a positive technical trend.

Jai Corp gained 8.87% to ₹101.09, trading above its 30-day (₹92.85) and 50-day (₹96.23) SMAs, but below its 150-day (₹105.35) and 200-day (₹108.11) SMAs. The stock's position above short-term averages indicates improving near-term momentum, although longer-term technical trends remain weak.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.

North Eastern Carrying Corporation fell 7.43% to ₹17.69, trading below its 30-day SMA of ₹19.11 but above its 50-day (₹17.76), 150-day (₹16.15) and 200-day (₹16.02) SMAs. The stock's position below its short-term average indicates near-term weakness, while trading above its longer-term averages suggests some underlying support.

Grand Continent Hotels declined 6.22% to ₹105.65, trading below its 30-day (₹112.66), 50-day (₹107.11), 150-day (₹107.10) and 200-day (₹114.33) SMAs. Trading below all key moving averages signals sustained selling pressure and a weak technical trend across short-, medium- and long-term periods.

TGB Banquets dropped 5.08% to ₹8.96, trading below its 30-day (₹9.44), 50-day (₹9.42), 150-day (₹9.18) and 200-day (₹9.23) SMAs. The stock's position below all four key averages indicates broad-based technical weakness and continued downward momentum.
ESDS Software, Birla Cable, Modison among others were locked in their lower circuits, reflecting strong selling and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

SJVN, Reliance Power, India Cements, Jupiter Wagons, Medplus Health, TVS Holdings, KEC International, Gujarat Energy, Eris Life, Vishal Mega Marts, Avenue Supermarts were among others hit 52-week low.

title: Momentum Stocks: Smartlink Net, Jay Bharat Maruti, Jai Corp rise up to 16% on sheer momentum
